tabs.tab1_description:
Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye gemstone is considered to be the most beautiful and powerful variety of Chrysoberyl Cat’s Eye which comes in yellowish green color. The meaning of Cats Eye stone is pretty simple and refers to the optical effect of the vertical ray of light that passes through this gemstone is known as ‘Chatoyance’ as it makes it look like the eye of a cat.

Discovered by Geologist Abraham Gottlob Werner, this stone serves as a great instrument in neutralizing the malefic effects of planet Ketu. It was believed by people of the ancient world to attract good fortune. It is said to be the stone of protection against mishaps, evil schemes of enemies and accidents.

Kanak Khet Cats Eye is a miraculous stone which is believed to ward off evil and negative energies from the wearer’s life. It acts as a talisman and safeguards the wearer from unknown enemies and less known dangers. This stone is popularly known to attract unexpected wealth and prosperity and it also helps people to regain their lost wealth. 

Kanak Khet Cat’s Eye enhances determination, will power, intelligence, awareness, and knowledge. It also offers spiritual elevation. The Cat’s Eye amplifies and attracts good luck and positivity. It helps to dispel all the negative energy that weighs the aura of an individual down.

In Vedic astrology, Kanak Kheth Cat's Eye gemstones are highly regarded for their metaphysical and powerful properties. These gemstones enhance intuition and insight, helping individuals make informed decisions and navigate life's challenges confidently. Kanak Kheth Cat's Eye gemstones offer protection from negative energies and psychic conflicts, making them popular for spiritual balance and protection. 

Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye gemstones are believed to attract prosperity and luck, symbolizing abundance and good fortune in many cultures. It is a stone that fulfills wishes of the wearer and brings good luck. It is also known to keep negative energies at bay.

The gemologists refer to the top quality Kanak Khet Cat’s Eye as the ‘Milk Cat’s Eye’ or the ‘Honey Cat’s Eye’. Regardless of its green-yellow color, its cosmic color is infra-red, which is associated with the first chakra (the root chakra) which is located at the base of the spine. Cat’s eye gemstone is therefore associated with all the essential needs for our survival, all the things that provide us with safety and allow us to live.

Kanak Khet means golden colour and Dhumra Khet means smoky grey colour. Shastras recommend using Cat’s Eye Chrysoberyl for Jyotisha (astrological) benefits related to the natal position of planet Ketu in the birth chart.

Other Names: Leshunia

Kanak Kheth gemstone, also known as Chrysoberyl Cat's Eye, is commonly recommended for people who want to improve their intuition, mental clarity, and protection against negative energies. In Vedic astrology, it is particularly associated with the planet Ketu, and as such, it is frequently recommended for those with a troubling Ketu influence in their birth chart. 

Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye should be worn by teachers, priests, and scientists. Those who work in administrative departments, as soldiers, or as rulers are required to wear the Honey brown Kanak Kheth Cats Eye. It can also be worn by businessmen, farmers, and bankers. 

Wearing Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye (Leshunia) is believed to help people overcome obstacles, gain insight, and make wise decisions. People who work in professions that require intuition and sharp judgment, as well as those seeking spiritual growth and psychic protection, may benefit from wearing this gemstone. 

Important Details:  

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye gemstones.  

Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye Buying Guide

Check its Origin. 

Kanak Kheth Cat's Eye gemstones are primarily sourced from the states of Orissa, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Bihar in India where mines produce Kanak Kheth Cat's Eye gemstones which are known for their golden to yellowish-green colour and chatoyancy, highly valued by gemstone collectors. Kanak Kheth Cat's Eye gemstones are also sourced from Sri Lanka and Brazil and less commonly in other parts of the world.

Observe their Color.

The Kanak Kheth Cat's Eye gemstone is known for its golden to yellowish-green colour. Its distinct and lively colour distinguishes it from other Cat's Eye gemstones, which can vary from green to black. The unique shade of golden yellow to greenish-yellow in Kanak Khet Cat's Eye gemstones adds to their beauty and rarity, making them highly desired by gemstone enthusiasts and collectors.

Notice their Clarity. 

Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye gemstones vary in clarity, but are ideally valued for their high transparency and minimal visible inclusions or flaws. Gemstones with excellent clarity enhance the chatoyant effect and visual appeal of Kanak Kheth Cat's Eye gemstones. Gemstones with better clarity and transparency are more valuable and sought after, leading to higher prices in the market.

Examine their Inclusions.

Kanak Khet Cats eye has inclusions which are looked-for in cat's eye gemstones because they contribute to the chatoyancy effect. However, inclusions that are too prominent or disrupt the chatoyancy effect can diminish the stone's value. Due to the presence of multiple fibrous mineral inclusions, Kanak Kheth Cat's Eyes stones show color variations.

See their Shape.

The most common and traditional shape for Kanak Kheth Cat's Eye gemstones is cabochon. This cut has a rounded, smooth top and a flat or curved bottom. The rounded shape enhances the chatoyancy effect and enables proper light reflection, thus producing the cat's eye effect.

Check the Carats. 

For Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye of gem quality, the raw Cat’s Eye is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Cat’s Eye weighing between 5 and 7 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because Cat’s Eye is sold by weight, Cat’s Eye prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Cat’s Eye has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye

Due to treatments the Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Cat’s Eye do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate 

It is recommended that you should purchase Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye gemstones along with a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Cat’s Eye are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Cat’s Eye from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Cat’s Eye gemstone to someone else? 

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Cat’s Eye gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Cat’s Eye is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity).  

Color 

Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye is earthed in beautiful golden-yellow to greenish-yellow hues.

Cut 

Best quality Cat’s Eye stones have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area, such as cabochons, rounds and ovals.

Carat 

Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye of 5 – 7 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Cat’s Eye are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Cat’s Eye rises as the size/weight/carat increases.   

Clarity 

For the clarity of a Kanak Kheth Cats Eye, the size, quantity, and overall appearance of inclusions are key factors. Like other gemstones, Cats Eyes do contain some inclusions visible, being from opaque to translucent in appearance. Those with no inclusions to the unaided eye are super-rare and valuable. Thus, the Kanak Kheth Cats Eye with some inclusions are accepted as well. Kanak Kheth Cats Eye with the least inclusions and best clarity are considered the best. 

 

Traders deal in Kanak Kheth Cats Eye synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is important that you purchase the stone only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.   

 

Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye gemstone Price

Kanak Khet Cats Eye gemstone prices vary based on size, quality, color, and chatoyancy. Larger stones with intense golden to yellowish-green color and a sharp cat's eye effect are more expensive. High-quality specimens with transparency, few inclusions, and a strong chatoyant band can be valuable.

 

Kanak Kheth Cats Eye gemstones range in price from a few hundred to several thousand dollars per carat. Consider factors carefully and consult a reputable gemstone dealer or expert for an accurate assessment of the gem's value. Treated gemstones should be avoided.

 

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Cat’s Eye has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Cat’s Eye stone should be worn.

 

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Cat’s Eye Kanak Kheth gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 23,770 to INR 2,61,700 (USD 292 to USD 3.218).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Kanak Khet Cats Eye?

The best way to check the authenticity of Kanak Kheth Cats Eye is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Cat’s Eye are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Cat’s Eye carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Cat’s Eye is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Cat’s Eye have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Cat’s Eye, but if you find flaws, then your Cat’s Eye is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Cat’s Eye are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Cat’s Eye. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Cat’s Eye, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Cat’s Eye from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Cat’s Eye. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Cat’s Eye. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

 

Kanak Kheth Cat’s Eye Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well. 

Kanak Kheth Cats Eye are Chrysoberyl gemstones, hence they are resilient enough to be cleansed with ultrasonic cleansers or steamers, but care must always be taken. Chrysoberyl is considered to be exceptionally durable and resilient, but sapphire and diamond can readily damage it. 

Use a gentle cloth and plain soapy water to maintain your gemstones; avoid bleach and other abrasive household cleansers. Be careful to thoroughly rinse to remove any residue from detergents.
